basics.name: Mirela Ionescu
basics.label: Senior Data Engineer
basics.summary: Data engineer with nine years on production data platforms, currently owning the analytics platform for a 400-person UK retailer. Migrates live, business-critical pipelines without breaking the numbers: rebuilt a nightly Spark pipeline from 6h10m to 1h50m and moved 60 legacy stored procedures onto a modern stack with no reporting gap. Runs event-driven ingestion on Kafka with schema contracts across 27 producing feeds. Moving deliberately toward stateful stream processing.

work.name: Halcyon Retail Group
work.summary: Own the analytics platform serving merchandising, supply chain and finance across 180 stores and the e-commerce estate.
highlights: Migrated the nightly sales and stock pipeline to Spark and Airflow with no interruption to customer-facing reporting, cutting critical-path runtime from 6h10m to 1h50m and taking the 07:00 SLA from two misses a month to zero across 14 months.
Built a Kafka-based stock-movement feed with published schema contracts, consumed by three downstream teams, replacing a 15-minute polling job and bringing store-level stock latency under 30 seconds.
Established data contracts and CI contract tests across 240 dbt models, cutting schema-drift incidents in production from 11 in 2023 to 2 in 2025.
Reduced platform AWS spend by £14k per month (31%) by replacing 40 daily always-on EMR hours with transient clusters and tiering cold history to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval.
Mentored two junior engineers to independent production delivery within a year.

work.name: Halcyon Retail Group
highlights: Migrated 60 live SQL Server stored procedures to Redshift and dbt in staged cutovers with no reporting downtime, retiring a £40k annual licence.

Designed the ingestion framework still used for all 27 third-party supplier feeds, handling schema evolution and backwards compatibility across multiple external publishers and cutting new-feed onboarding from three days to half a day.
Added automated data-quality validation to the ten highest-impact tables, catching a corrupted supplier price feed before it reached the pricing team.

work.name: Vantiq Software
highlights: Built a Python and Airflow ingestion service processing 4M insurance claim records daily for the firm's largest client.
Reduced a client's month-end close run from 9 hours to 40 minutes by rewriting a row-by-row Oracle procedure as set-based SQL.
Delivered ETL and reporting platforms across six regulated insurance and telecoms engagements.

work.name: Vantiq Software
highlights: Built Python and Django REST services for client-facing insurance portals.
Introduced the team's first automated test suite, raising coverage on the core billing service from 0% to 71%.

projects.name: stockstream
projects.description: Open-source toolkit for replaying retail stock-movement events against a local Kafka cluster, used for load-testing streaming consumers.
highlights: Replays 2M recorded events at configurable rates to exercise consumer backpressure and ordering behaviour.
Around 300 GitHub stars; adopted by two teams outside the original employer.
